steps.command:
cat > /tmp/test_it.py << 'EOF'
import pytest
@pytest.mark.skip
def test_skip_location() -> None:
    assert 0
EOF
cd /testbed && source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate && conda activate testbed
pytest -rs /tmp/test_it.py
echo "---with runxfail---"
pytest -rs --runxfail /tmp/test_it.py
cd /testbed && source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate && conda activate testbed && pytest -rA testing/test_skipping.py testing/python/collect.py -q 2>&1 | tail -40

cd /testbed && source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate && conda activate testbed && git stash && pytest -q testing/python/collect.py::TestModule::test_import_prepend_append testing/python/collect.py::TestTracebackCutting::test_filter_traceback_path_no_longer_valid 2>&1 | tail -20; git stash pop
cd /testbed && source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate && conda activate testbed && pytest -q testing/test_skipping.py 2>&1 | tail -20
